text: This FiftyFive Technologies Policy on client escalation matrix is released for use in FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited with effect from 01 January 2026. This document is subject to FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited Procedure and subject to change any time as per the company policy.

Purpose The Client Escalation Matrix is designed to provide a structured approach for escalating client issues based on their severity and impact. It ensures timely resolution and appropriate involvement of relevant stakeholders.

Scope This matrix applies to all client-related issues and incidents requiring escalation within the organization. It covers the escalation process from initial contact to resolution, including the roles and responsibilities of each escalation level.

Frontline Support Team: ❖ Address initial client issues and follow standard procedures. ❖ Escalate issues as required.
Support Supervisor: ❖ Oversee unresolved or complex issues. ❖ Ensure effective communication and timely resolution.
Support Manager: ❖ Handle critical issues and develop resolution strategies. ❖ Provide regular updates to stakeholders and clients.
Executive Contact: ❖ Manage severe issues with significant impact. ❖ Ensure overall client satisfaction and resolution.
